events.text: Hanover received town privileges.

evidence.quote: receiving town privileges in 1241

events.label: festival founding
events.text: Schützenfest Hannover festival founded.

evidence.quote: Founded in 1529 , it consists of more than 260 rides and inns

events.text: Duke George moved his residence to Hanover, becoming capital of Calenberg.

evidence.quote: In 1636 George , Duke of Brunswick-Lüneburg , ruler of the Brunswick-Lüneburg principality of Calenberg , moved his residence to Hanover
Hanover was the capital of the Principality of Calenberg ( 1636–1692 )

events.label: elevation
events.text: Principality of Calenberg upgraded to Electorate of Hanover.

evidence.quote: The Dukes of Brunswick-Lüneburg were elevated by the Holy Roman Emperor to the rank of Prince-Elector in 1692
the Electorate of Hanover ( 1692–1814 )

events.label: elevation
events.text: Imperial Diet confirmed the Electorate elevation.

evidence.quote: this elevation was confirmed by the Imperial Diet in 1708

events.text: Hanover became family seat of the Hanoverian kings under personal union with UK.

evidence.quote: From 1714 to 1837 Hanover was by personal union the family seat

events.text: Battle of Hastenbeck near the city; French army occupied Hanover.

evidence.quote: the Battle of Hastenbeck was fought near the city on 26 July 1757

events.label: recapture
events.text: City recaptured by Anglo-German forces led by Ferdinand of Brunswick.

evidence.quote: It was recaptured by Anglo-German forces led by Ferdinand of Brunswick the following year

evidence.quote: After Napoleon imposed the Convention of Artlenburg ( Convention of the Elbe ) on July 5 , 1803

events.text: Electorate of Hanover ended; Kingdom of Hanover began (per this source).

evidence.quote: the Electorate of Hanover ( 1692–1814 ) , the Kingdom of Hanover ( 1814–1866 )

evidence.quote: The Congress of Vienna in 1815 elevated the electorate to the Kingdom of Hanover

evidence.quote: In 1837 , the personal union of the United Kingdom and Hanover ended

evidence.quote: In 1842 the first horse railway was inaugurated

evidence.quote: remained a kingdom until 1866 , when it was annexed by Prussia during the Austro-Prussian war
the Kingdom of Hanover ( 1814–1866 )

became the capital of the Prussian Province of Hanover

undated_mentions: became a comparatively large town in the 13th century
in the 14th century the main churches and a city wall with three gates were built
after 1937 the lord mayor and state commissioners were NSDAP members
during World War II seven concentration camps were constructed in Hanover
during World War II bombing raids (88 raids) destroyed more than 90% of the city centre
after the war the Aegidienkirche was not rebuilt and its ruins became a war memorial
after the war a large group of Orthodox Jewish survivors settled in Hanover
